owner_source.source_ref: Owner Claude session, 2026-09-26: 'yes fix it' sent 14:53Z in reply to the secondary relay outage report; 'yes to all 4' sent 16:12Z approving the four listed steps (platform-reported send times, minute precision)

normalized_outcome: Restore sending on the active SECONDARY relay, which has sent nothing since 2026-09-24T19:48:57Z because ChatGPT's September 2026 page no longer matches the relay's page contract (no #prompt-textarea, no send/stop test IDs, new model menu and app list). Update the relay's page contract, install it on both hosts under the existing fence/rollback rules, extend the SECONDARY lease without changing its authority fields, and prove recovery with a real provider send.

required_outcomes.observable: The relay recognizes the September 2026 composer, model control, Power slider effort status, app list and Remove pills, and Send/Stop controls; tests exercise the recorded page structures and every earlier selector stays as a fallback.
required_outcomes.live_note: Merged as 3d4754f and installed on both hosts. Composer, model button and 'Add files and more' recognition are observed live on SECONDARY: the window-replacement commit ran only after the installed readiness check found a visible composer, and a read-only probe of the live tab at 2026-09-26T18:39:34Z with the installed relay's own page functions reported ready, composer found, one model control (closed), one tools control and idle-ready. The read-only doctor's READY is binding and scheduler state and is not composer evidence. Opening the model menu, setting Power, selecting apps and Send are first exercised by the next queued request, so this outcome stays unverified.

required_outcomes.observable: On SECONDARY the open automation-window replacement commits through the central coordinator, the read-only doctor reports ready, and the relay lock stays held by the persistent service.
A real provider send goes through the relay after the install: the ledger gains a new submission after 2026-09-24T19:48:57Z with exact controls verified and no duplicate or ambiguous submission.
required_outcomes.live_note: Not yet possible: all 13 requests the relay can see expired (newest queued 2026-09-24T15:50:39Z), so nothing is eligible to send until a worker queues a new supervision request.

required_outcomes.observable: The SECONDARY lease is extended by a same-identity renewal (only expiresAt changes) before or after its 2026-09-27T00:00Z expiry, and the central scheduler reports ACTIVE_LEASE.
required_outcomes.live_note: Renewal to 2026-10-27T00:00:00.000Z is prepared as an owner-run command (same lease identity, only expiresAt changes, automatic rollback); not yet run at 2026-09-26T18:25Z.

non_satisfying_proxies: Green unit tests against recorded page structures do not prove the live page accepts the relay's clicks and keystrokes.
A committed window replacement or a ready doctor does not prove a send; only a new ledger submission does.
An installed tree hash does not prove the running relay loaded it.
next_direct_evidence: Owner runs the prepared same-identity lease renewal before 2026-09-27T00:00Z. When a worker next queues a supervision request, read the relay journal, read-only doctor and central ledger until a new provider submission is recorded, or until the step that failed closed is identified.
